title: kate-ui: leave a live view after the last close
summary: close_one opens one blank document when the close removes the last view. A modified document stays open. A second view stays put. The test runs on macOS.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The test builds only on macOS. The change stays under about 60 lines.

definitions.definition: fn close_one(ws: &mut kate_core::Workspace, view: kate_core::ViewId) -> FileEffect

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Edit close_one in crates/kate-ui/src/files.rs. A missing view still returns FileEffect::UnknownView before close_view. RefusedModified still returns FileEffect::RefusedModified and leaves that view open. After CloseResult::Closed, when ws.views.is_empty(), call ws.new_document and then ws.new_view on that document. new_view sets active_view. When new_view returns None, leave the workspace empty. When views is not empty, add no document. Return FileEffect::Ready after a Closed result. Leave workspace.rs unchanged. The window calls apply_file_request, and follow_active then shows the new active view. Add the test in the existing macos tests module. close_of_the_last_view_leaves_a_live_view builds a workspace, makes one document and one view, and closes that view. The effect is Ready. The old view id is absent. The old document id is absent. active_view is Some. That view id is present. It differs from the closed view. views.len is 1. documents.len is 1. A second fresh workspace has two documents and two views. Closing the first returns Ready. views.len is 1. The second view is present. documents.len is 1. The second document is present. A third fresh workspace closes ViewId::default. The effect is UnknownView. documents.len stays 0. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep this change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: files::tests::close_of_the_last_view_leaves_a_live_view
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because active_view is None after the last close. The effect is Ready. The closed view and its document are gone. active_view names a different live view. One view and one document remain. Closing one of two views leaves the other view and adds no blank. An unknown view returns UnknownView and adds no document. The test builds on macOS.
